raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Allow the weight-cache daemon to reuse AWQ/GPTQ linear weights already packed for Marlin across engine restarts. Related to #56049; updated against main `8cf1277362aef963a71cf6860c28387acf6ecb90`.

## Claims

- Support AWQ INT4 and symmetric GPTQ INT4/INT8 linear weights with the actual Marlin kernel and FP16/BF16 activations.
- Preserve shared repacked weights, scales, zero points and padded bias without repeating checkpoint conversion or Marlin transformations.
- Continue rejecting other kernels, INT8/FP8 activation overrides and AWQ/GPTQ MoE.

## Validation

November 3 integration update: preserve the GPTQ batch-invariant ordinary-loading path from #60479 and restore the symmetric Marlin runtime zero-point name after #62407. The latter now keeps checkpoint `qzeros` registered and reads a separate empty `w_zp`; an IPC attachment must restore that kernel metadata and mark checkpoint `qzeros` retired. No tensor data is transformed on attachment. The existing tests reproduced 5 failures (GPTQ real-model IPC and four layer cases) before this correction, with 6 passing. Final results: **11 passed, 68 deselected in 244.14s** on B300 (same two pinned real models, ordinary/fallback/IPC/restart with `fallback=False`, plus nine layer/boundary cases). A real CPU/Gloo GPTQ construction check also preserves checkpoint tensors in batch-invariant mode and rejects Marlin IPC without initializing CUDA. Changed-file hooks pass, including mypy and CI tethering. Existing torch/fork deprecation warnings remain; no L4 Buildkite run is claimed.


B300, TP1. The two real-model cases use FP16, eager execution, TRITON_ATTN, explicitly selected Marlin, two prompts × 16 generated tokens, and prompt/sample top-5 logprobs. Each compares ordinary loading → missing-daemon disk fallback → IPC → second IPC; both IPC starts set `fallback=False`. Comparison uses the existing `check_logprobs_close` helper. `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=0` is intentional: AWQ and GPTQ use unpacked implementations when enabled, and Marlin does not guarantee batch invariance.

| Check | Before implementation | After implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Pinned Qwen2.5-0.5B AWQ and GPTQ-INT4 checkpoints | 2 failed, 118.22s; ordinary/fallback generation works, both daemons reject their quant method | 2 passed, 144.56s, all four loading paths |
| Real fused INT4 layers, aligned/padded outputs and bias | 4 failed, 32.41s: pre-processed weights rejected | All pass, with exact output/shape/shared-pointer/tensor-content checks across two attachments |
| Final layer/boundary suite, including GPTQ INT8/channelwise BF16 and actual Triton/A8 rejection | — | 9 passed, 12.92s |
| Existing AWQ/GPTQ config and weight-cache regressions | — | 76 passed, 18 deselected, 63.38s |
| Changed-file hooks | — | Passed, including mypy, ruff and CI test tethering |

Checkpoints: `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-AWQ` at `db09cd27ead7fee40cdee309693cf83601b9c899`; `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4` at `c34a4a91629f09f73a285f32dbd26106b033c654`. INT8/BF16 and padded outputs are covered by real CUDA layers, not a complete INT8 checkpoint. This is cache-versus-ordinary output equivalence, not quantization accuracy against BF16 or a performance benchmark. Multi-GPU, other hardware and other kernels are not claimed.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction and baseline evidence</summary>

```bash
# Run each on an idle GPU; HF_HUB_OFFLINE assumes the pinned models are cached.
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py -k marlin_preprocessed -q
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py -k ipc_cache_marlin -q
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_auto_awq.py tests/quantization/test_auto_gptq.py tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py -k 'not quantization_method and not cold_start and not d2d_warmup and not marlin' -q
```

Apply the new tests to main `6376fda7a9` without the two production changes to reproduce the failures. Before implementation, the real daemons report:

```text
UnsupportedQuantForIPCError: layer model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj:
AutoAWQMarlinLinearMethod does not support loading from pre-processed weights.
UnsupportedQuantForIPCError: layer model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj:
AutoGPTQLinearMethod does not support loading from pre-processed weights.
2 failed, 74 deselected, 16 warnings in 118.22s
```

Host-specific environment: its precompiled Marlin path first failed with unsupported PTX during ordinary loading. Baseline and passing results above both use process-local `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/liusy/codex-runtime/cuda-compat-13-4/usr/local/cuda-13.4/compat`, containing NVIDIA's checksum-verified `cuda-compat-13-4` package `615.71.10-1ubuntu1`, as supported by [NVIDIA's compatibility matrix](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/latest/forward-compatibility.html). It was extracted under the user's task directory; the host driver and shared Python environment were not modified. Initial environment failures and corrected negative-test setup errors are retained separately and are not represented as cache bug reproductions. Runs emit existing torch/fork deprecation warnings.

</details>

## Details

Both methods previously rejected daemon caching even though ordinary Marlin loading worked. Their kernel configuration is constructed before post-load processing. Normal post-load work converts AWQ packing and/or repacks weights, permutes scales/zero points, pads/permutates bias and selects the symmetric GPTQ runtime zero-point name. IPC already supplies transformed tensors; the GPTQ attachment restores the runtime name and retirement metadata. Opt in only the actual `MarlinLinearKernel` with FP16/BF16 activations, and return before those transformations on the pre-processed path. No common loading interface, kernel implementation, scheduler/model-runner change or steady-state synchronization is added.

Reuse the existing daemon, generation and comparison helpers. The L4 Marlin Preload CI step selects the real-model and layer/boundary cases and tracks their source dependencies. Local validation is B300; L4 Buildkite execution is not claimed. The preload guide documents commands, defaults and exclusions, with links from the AWQ/GPTQ guides.

Duplicate checks covered current #56049/comments, issue-linked drafts and open Marlin-preload/AWQ/GPTQ-cache searches. #61908 introduces a different on-disk AWQ-v2 format, while #60479 changes GPTQ batch-invariant execution; neither restores daemon IPC weights. Existing FP8/FP4 cache drafts do not cover this path.

AI assistance: Codex implemented and ran the recorded validation at the submitter's request. This draft is for human review; no completed human approval or human-run tests are asserted.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Narrow capability opt-in using existing kernel construction and loading interfaces.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Real-model and layer before/after checks, shared tensor preservation, regression and CI coverage recorded above.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Changed-file hooks passed; discoverable support documentation and CI selection included.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Root cause, duplicate checks, commands, limitations, environment and AI disclosure included.
</details>
